caption: The drawing shows a detailed depiction of a two-part wooden cabinet, rendered in a reddish-brown color. The upper section of the cabinet has two vertically aligned rectangular glass doors with a crisscross diamond grid pattern, framed by the wood. The lower section features three rectangular wooden panel doors. The cabinet stands on four short legs with a rounded, claw-like design. The background is a plain, cream-colored paper. The main cabinet drawing is centered within a faintly sketched square. Below the main drawing, there are two smaller technical sketches: one on the left shows a left-side sectional view with labeled dimensions, and one on the right shows a front elevation with corresponding measurements. The composition focuses on the cabinet, using clean, straight lines and emphasizing the form and construction details through its colored and technical representations.
title: Bookcase
